create_wrapper_env: create a TrajectoryGeneratorWrapperEnv instance wrapping a gym environment with a trajectory generator controller
reset_wrapper_env: reset the wrapped environment with optional initial motor angles and reset duration parameters
step_wrapper_env: step the wrapped environment by passing an action through the trajectory generator and returning modified observations
review_trajectory_generator_interface: review the trajectory generator interface requiring get_action and get_observation methods to be implemented
summarize_wrapper_delegation: summarize how the wrapper delegates unknown attributes to the underlying gym environment via __getattr__
